description: Frozen dataset used for all numbers in the paper. One row per one-second interval; 2 real columns (RPS, Payload_Size_KB) and 4 simulated columns.

source_log.name: access.log (nginx combined format), e-commerce site zanbil.ir
source_log.original: Zaker, F. (2019). Online Shopping Store - Web Server Logs. Harvard Dataverse, V1. doi:10.7910/DVN/3QBYB5

outlier_filter.rule: average latency < 1 ms or > 2000 ms, or RPS > 5000

generator.latency: per request 15 ms + 0.5 ms/KB * payload + N(0, 5 ms), averaged over the second
generator.cpu_penalty: +12 ms per CPU percentage point above 80 % (added after the outlier filter); active in 1 interval

notes: The file was produced by an earlier version of src/prepare_data.py with the same generator parameters; the current script reproduces the real columns but draws a new random sample for the simulated ones.
Last row: RPS is 44 in the CSV, 43 in the log (one extra line read by the earlier script version).
